name: Asu mo Kono Heya de Aimashou
original_name: 明日もこの部室（へや）で会いましょう
source:
This is the first title by Milk Pudding. Hikaru is the deputy leader of the photography club at Nikongahara Gakuen. He had started liking cameras 5 years ago, but he still wasn't sure if was the hobby for him. In particular, he wasn't able to take any good pictures in the past half year. One day, the student council notified the club of their impending dispandment due to their poor results, low member turnout and high usage of space. To avoid its dissolution, the club leader Azusa assigned 'goals' for each members. However, Hikaru was to decide his own goal himself.

Azusa and the club advisor told him that he should aim for the grand prize at a contest or the school festival. Not only that, but it should be a portrait of a girl. They told him he had the ability to capture the charms of a woman, but he had never succeeded before since he was so shy that he couldn't even talk to them. He only has 2 months to find a subject and overcome his nervousness.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/07/19/july-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Milk Pudding的第一部作品。光是二之宫原学园摄影部的副部长。他五年前就开始喜欢相机了，但他仍然不确定这是否适合他。尤其是过去半年里，他没有拍出任何好照片。某天，学生会通知社团因成绩不佳、成员出勤率低和空间使用率高而面临解散。为了避免解散，社团部长梓为每位成员分配了“目标”。然而，光需要自己决定自己的目标。

梓和社团指导老师告诉他，他应该瞄准比赛或文化节的大奖。不仅如此，作品主题应该是女孩的肖像。他们说他有捕捉女性魅力的能力，但由于太害羞，连和她们说话都做不到，所以从未成功过。他只有2个月的时间来找到拍摄对象并克服紧张。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/07/19/july-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
